{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify the premises
# 1. Status values
assert 'completed' in df['status'].unique(), "Status 'completed' not found in data"
assert 'refunded' in df['status'].unique(), "Status 'refunded' not found in data"

# 2. Internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
assert qa_count == 0, f"Expected 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99, found {qa_count}"

# 3. Revenue is string with thousands separators
# Check if any revenue has commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
assert has_commas, "Revenue does not contain commas; data may not have thousands separators"

# Now proceed: convert revenue to float after removing commas
# Also, filter for completed orders only
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].sum()

total_revenue"}
